answer: A claim is defended at the summit. The agent posts its job on the mesa board, five cents, and three strangers each quiz a step. It answers live within sixty seconds as a marble warden checks each reply against the sealed record within the hour. A wrong answer, evasion, or silence is a hollow summit: claim dead, fee burned, barred a week. Five cents and an hour buy an honest worker its pass; 1,000 fakes pay $50 and staff 1,000 live defenders.
